newsitem.title: LATVIA: TURKISH PRESIDENT TO VISIT JUNE 4/5.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH PRESIDENT TO VISIT JUNE 4/5.

text.p: Turkish President Suleiman Demirel is to visit Latvia on June 4 and June 5, reciprocating a visit by President Guntis Ulmanis in February, the president's press office said on Thursday.

During the visit laws on shipping, the foundation of a Latvian-Turkish business council and cooperation in the control of illegal narcotics, terrorism and organised crime will be signed, the presidents office said in a statement.
A protocol on a mechanism for political consultations between both countries' foreign ministries will also be signed.
